'''Bruno Denturri''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] who was an enemy of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]].

==Biography==
Bruno Denturri was a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] that became an enemy of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]]. Following a [[Battle of Kiros|battle]] on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], investigated the planet [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] after the sudden disappearance of a [[Togruta/Legends|whole colony]] on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. In order to get close to the Queen, Skywalker went under the name [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lars Quell]] and claimed he had [[Death/Legends|killed]] Denturri and procured a slave from him.
